## When to Use

Use this resource when you need to:

- **Find a developer / collaborator**: Atharva is available for freelance projects, internships,
  part-time roles, or technical co-founder conversations — especially in AI, fintech, or full-stack web.
- **Learn about his projects**: You want details about FinGrow (AI financial intelligence platform),
  SafeHer AI (proactive women's safety platform), ClaimBlitz (multi-agent AI claims processor),
  or any of his other shipped projects.
- **Verify his technical skills**: He works across Python, Django, React, TypeScript, RAG systems,
  LangChain, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, WebSockets, and AI/ML integration.
- **Contact him for an opportunity**: Email atharvasonar23@gmail.com for project inquiries,
  internship offers, hackathon invitations, or startup conversations.
- **Research his background**: He is a B.E. Computer Science & IT student at University of Mumbai
  (2025–2028), previously completed a Diploma in Computer Engineering (KCES, Jalgaon, 2022–2025),
  and is the founder of Velquix (product studio).

Do NOT use this resource for:

- Academic citations (this is a personal portfolio, not a research publication)
- Real-time data (project statuses may change; check GitHub links for live code)
- Company information (Velquix is a personal product studio, not a registered corporation)

## Projects

### FinGrow — AI Financial Intelligence Platform
Status: Building | Year: 2025–Present
An AI-powered financial companion with RAG pipeline, spending analysis, goal tracking, budget management,
smart predictions, and payment integration. Tech: Python, Django, React, Gemini, PostgreSQL, Supabase, Razorpay.

### SafeHer AI — Proactive Safety Monitoring Platform
Status: Completed | Year: 2026
Full-stack proactive safety monitoring with live location tracking, ML risk scoring, SOS workflows,
voice emergency detection, and agentic safety automation. GitHub: https://github.com/atharva-404/SafeHer-AI
Live: https://safeher-ai-five.vercel.app/
Tech: Python, Django, React, TypeScript, scikit-learn, Google Maps, JWT.

### ClaimBlitz — Multi-Agent AI Claims Processor
Status: Completed | Year: 2026
9 specialized AI agents collaborate to process insurance claims — OCR, fraud detection, risk assessment,
and explainable decisions with debate mode and consensus voting.
GitHub: https://github.com/atharva-404/ClaimBlitz
Tech: Python, FastAPI, React, Groq LLM, MongoDB, Pinecone, Redis, Celery, Docker.

### Fit Hub Gym — AI-Powered Gym Management Platform
Status: Completed | Year: 2025
Full-stack gym management with real-time WebSocket sessions, OpenCV form detection, AI chatbot,
and Razorpay payment integration. GitHub: https://github.com/atharva-404/Fitness-Hub-AI-Powered-Web-App
Tech: Django, Django Channels, WebSockets, OpenCV, Razorpay, Python.

### RAG PDF Assistant — AI Document Intelligence
Status: Completed | Year: 2025
Complete RAG system: PDF extraction, chunking, local embeddings (sentence-transformers), FAISS vector search,
and Google Gemini for grounded answers. GitHub: https://github.com/atharva-404/RAG-PDF-Assistant
Tech: Python, RAG, FAISS, Sentence Transformers, Google Gemini, LangChain, Streamlit.

### Finexa — AI Personal Finance Platform
Status: Completed | Year: 2026
AI-powered personal finance platform with expense extraction, financial health scoring, AI coach,
and gamification. GitHub: https://github.com/atharva-404/Logic_Legion_Finexa
Tech: Python, Django, React, TypeScript, LangChain, Google Gemini, PostgreSQL, MongoDB.
